Implement GraphService methods: [create_node() lines 48-73, get_node() lines 75-90, create_herb() lines 125-175, link_herb_parent() lines 177-195, link_herb_child() lines 197-215, link_herb_source() lines 217-235, get_herb_graph() lines 237-290, verify_node() lines 350-380, verify_relationship() lines 382-420]

pre_analysis.action: Load context package for Neo4j driver patterns and GraphService implementation
Load GraphService source to understand all methods requiring tests
Load conftest.py to understand existing test infrastructure

implementation_approach.title: Red Phase - Write Failing Tests
implementation_approach.description: Write 10 test cases that define expected GraphService behavior
modification_points: Write 10 test cases: test_create_node, test_get_node, test_get_node_not_found, test_create_herb, test_link_herb_parent, test_link_herb_child, test_link_herb_source, test_get_herb_graph, test_verify_node, test_verify_relationship
Each test uses mocked Neo4j driver with predefined responses
logic_flow: Create mock_async_driver fixture returning predefined Cypher query results
Write test_create_node verifying node creation with correct label and properties
Write test_get_node verifying node retrieval by ID
Write test_get_node_not_found verifying None return for missing nodes
Write test_create_herb verifying Herb node creation with all properties
Write test_link_herb_parent verifying PARENT_OF relationship creation
Write test_link_herb_child verifying CHILD_OF relationship creation
Write test_link_herb_source verifying ORIGINATED_FROM relationship creation
Write test_get_herb_graph verifying full subgraph retrieval
Write test_verify_node verifying NodeStatus update to VERIFIED
Write test_verify_relationship verifying relationship verification

implementation_approach.title: Green Phase - Implement to Pass Tests
implementation_approach.description: Implement GraphService methods following the existing implementation pattern
modification_points: Create mock Neo4j driver fixture in conftest.py if not exists
Implement all GraphService methods following existing pattern (singleton, async/await)
Ensure all methods return expected dict structures matching test expectations
logic_flow: If mock fixture missing, add mock_async_driver to conftest.py
Verify GraphService already implements: create_node (lines 48-73), get_node (lines 75-90)
Verify/ensure create_herb exists with proper herb node creation
Verify/ensure link_herb_parent, link_herb_child, link_herb_source exist
Verify/ensure get_herb_graph returns nodes and edges structure
Verify/ensure verify_node updates NodeStatus
Verify/ensure verify_relationship updates relationship properties
Run tests - if failures, fix implementation not tests

implementation_approach.title: Refactor Phase - Improve Code Quality
implementation_approach.description: Apply refactorings to improve code quality without breaking tests
modification_points: Apply 3 refactorings: extract Cypher query strings to constants, add type hints, create node mapping helper
logic_flow: Extract all Cypher query strings to module-level constants (e.g., CREATE_NODE_CYPHER)
Add explicit return type hints to all public methods
Create _map_node_to_dict helper method to reduce duplication in get_node, get_herb_graph
Run full test suite to verify refactoring didn't break anything
Run coverage report to confirm >=80%
